title: Null pointer dereference in AMD Embedded SPI Flash driver could allow a local user to potentially… (CVE-2026-0470)
description: CVE-2026-0470 is a vulnerability in the AMD Embedded SPI Flash driver involving a null pointer dereference. This flaw could allow a local user to cause a loss of availability on the affected system. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.8. No specific affected versions or patches are provided in the available data.
